longterm_view.reasoning: The prospectus itself claims 5.98% revenue CAGR from Fiscal 2024 to Fiscal 2026 [business, page 205], which is slow for the valuation implied by EPS of ~41-42 and a price of 1,700-1,785 (roughly 40x earnings); the sharper contraction implied by the supplied year-on-year figures (-61% latest year) sits uneasily against the document's own five-period table [business, page 206] and cannot be fully reconciled from these extracts. The business has real franchise features (no concentrated customer/supplier dependence [business, page 380], core trading infrastructure [business, page 230]) but a persistent history of SEBI enforcement actions caps the score.

governance.reasoning: The company has been subject to repeated SEBI enforcement: an adjudication notice, a ₹60 million penalty [litigation, page 448], and non-monetary Whole-Time Member directions [litigation, page 458], with a risk factor conceding a pattern of regulatory action [litigation, page 459]. For a market-infrastructure institution this history is a genuine negative, not boilerplate.

key_risks.why_it_matters: A stock exchange whose own regulator has repeatedly taken enforcement action against it carries a structural credibility discount and uncertainty over future directions.
A ₹60 million penalty and pending matters involving alleged misuse of client funds and sought criminal complaints create contingent liabilities and reputational overhang.
